Net order value is quantity × unit price × (1 − discount percentage). I counted only Completed orders as net revenue.

- **q1:** March completed-order revenue totals **£16,983.75**.
- **q2:** Q2 completed-order revenue by region was East **£6,603.70**, South **£4,616.60**, West **£4,528.25**, and North **£3,668.65**.
- **q3:** No product grew from Q1 to Q2. Whiteboard had the smallest percentage decline: from **£4,617.00** to **£3,377.25**, a change of **−26.9%**.
- **q4:** Refunded and cancelled orders had combined discounted order value of **£8,754.10**.
- **q5:** Copperfield Law had the highest completed-order revenue, at **£7,222.40**.
- **q6:** Q1 revenue was **£45,320.90** across **68** completed orders, averaging **£666.48** per order.
